shorts.providerOrder: Eligible paid MoolSocial Reels remain first; only positively classified eligible YouTube Shorts participate in the same continuous vertical flow.
shorts.stage: One edge-to-edge Shorts canvas for MoolSocial and YouTube with no provider-specific side shrink.
shorts.fit: Center-crop inside the 9:16 safe canvas; never stretch media.
shorts.details: Controls and content details open with the item and remain available until the user explicitly hides them. More and Less expand or collapse long copy without a timer.
shorts.playControl: Use one compact premium frosted circular control with an icon-only solid play or pause glyph.
shorts.youtubeBoundary: YouTube attribution and official-player behavior remain visible and accurate. MoolSocial actions remain distinct from YouTube account actions.

videos.home: Native MoolSocial discovery cards use public metadata supported by the YouTube Data API; playback uses the official YouTube player surface.
videos.accountActions: YouTube account mutations require a separately connected YouTube account and remain provider actions.
videos.backNavigation: Do not show a duplicate page-level Videos back pill. Platform Back and back gesture restore Channel to Description, Description to Watch, and Watch to the exact Discovery state and meaningful scroll position.
videos.providerBoundary: Discovery and metadata are native MoolSocial UI. Playback is the official provider-owned YouTube player surface with truthful attribution and without copied YouTube navigation or protected trade dress.

feed.composer: An always-ready public composer appears on Feed for every authenticated MoolSocial account.
feed.result: Publishing stays on Feed and immediately exposes the new public item.

create.presentation: Create stays on one screen. Selecting a format replaces the workbench inside the current Create surface.
create.excludedOwnedFormat: MoolSocial does not host an owned long-form Video at MVP.
create.reel: The first Reel tap exposes Camera and Gallery immediately. No empty preview or additional format screen appears.
create.carousel: The first Carousel tap opens the image chooser immediately. After selection, 2–10 image slots, caption and Post Carousel remain in the same workbench.
create.post: The first Post tap focuses Share publicly immediately. Image, Image Poll, Quick Poll and Quiz are direct inline tools.
create.workspaceBoundary: A Creator or Business workspace is not required for ordinary public posting. It is required only for creator earnings, campaigns, brand selection, analytics and external-account distribution.

publicContent.sourceOfTruth: Published items are built from the authenticated account and the content held by the existing Social session owner. Blank or hard-coded public success cards are prohibited.

reel.presentation: A 9:16 full-height item in Shorts with creator identity, caption, optional More and Less, item-owned engagement controls and any truthful sponsor or commerce disclosure.

carousel.presentation: A public Feed card with creator identity, caption, image count, swipeable 2–10 images, position dots and item-owned engagement controls.

post.presentation: A public Feed card with creator identity, audience, publish time, complete text, optional image and item-owned engagement controls.

imagePoll.presentation: A public Feed card with a question and image choices. Before voting it shows selectable images; after voting it shows the selected choice, percentages, total votes and closing status.

quickPoll.presentation: A public Feed card with a question and text choices. After one deliberate vote it shows choice percentages, total votes and the truthful closing status.

quiz.presentation: A public Feed card with a question and answer choices. After one deliberate answer it identifies the chosen and correct answers and shows the result without leaving Feed.

bottomRail.focusedMode: The middle ribbon exposes every sub-action for the active world.
bottomRail.moolMode: Tapping Mool replaces only the middle ribbon with Social, Buy, Eat, Ride, Book, Pay and Work.
bottomRail.autoReveal: After every main-action or sub-action selection, reposition the middle ribbon so the active action and its next available action are visible.
bottomRail.motion: Use restrained selection motion and native selection haptics; respect reduced-motion and platform accessibility settings.

navigation.back: Return to the previous meaningful state without changing the accepted Screens 01–03 boundary.
navigation.forward: Restore a forward state only when a valid history entry exists.
navigation.root: Mool returns the middle ribbon to all seven main worlds in one tap.
navigation.chat: Chat is a direct destination and does not expose capability-ribbon previous or next controls.

typographyAndFitment.overflow: No horizontal page overflow, clipped action label, inaccessible content or undersized visible action.

customerCopy.rule: Visible copy contains only customer-facing actions, facts, outcomes, disclosures and recovery guidance.

nativeRules: Implement with native Flutter widgets; never render this HTML in a WebView.
Reuse existing non-UI sessions, services and route owners.
Do not import or modify the legacy Flutter presentation.
Do not modify accepted Screens 01, 02 or 03.
Do not integrate the live YouTube API until the native Gate 1 screen is founder-accepted.
Do not claim native acceptance before identical-viewport comparison and connected OPPO replay.
